name: How do I choose between custom and semi-custom cabinets?

mainEntity.name: Should I choose custom or semi-custom cabinets for a Los Angeles kitchen remodel?
mainEntity.text: Should I choose custom or semi-custom cabinets for a Los Angeles kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom and semi-custom cabinets serve different priorities. Custom cabinetry is the best option when the kitchen has unusual dimensions, when storage needs are highly specific, or when a homeowner wants exact control over materials, finishes, and internal organization. Semi-custom cabinets are often the better value when you want a polished, tailored appearance but do not need every dimension made from scratch. They can offer many of the same visual benefits at a lower cost and with faster lead times. In Los Angeles, where remodel budgets can stretch quickly, semi-custom is often the sweet spot for homeowners who want quality without committing to the highest price tier. The right choice depends on budget, timeline, and how much flexibility the room actually needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Custom cabinets offer the most flexibility in size, storage, and finish, but they cost more and usually take longer. Semi-custom cabinets cost less and still provide many size and style options, making them a strong choice when you want a tailored look without full custom pricing.
